mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced cost of capital and increased present value of future earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence and trigger negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months or mean return is significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units and industrial production below 100 index indicates weakening consumer demand and manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting HOUST < 1500 and INDPRO < 100 or Rank IC for interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles initiated by FEDFUNDS rising above 1.5% and remaining elevated for two consecutive months increase cost of capital, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 1.5% for 2 months or mean return is significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth exceeding 2.5% annualized quarterly (GDPC1 > 2.5%) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2.5% or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500 thousand units (HOUST < 1500) indicates contraction in residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500 or mean return is significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained payroll growth exceeding 145,000 thousand persons (PAYEMS > 145000) for three consecutive months signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and generates positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS > 145000 for 3 months or frequency of positive returns is below 50%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate rise above 5.5% and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%) indicates labor market weakness under accommodative policy, triggering negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with monetary accommodation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting UNRATE > 5.5% and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% or Rank IC for interaction is below 0.03.
